approval: L'utente considera ArtVision Cinema V6 il migliore dei video artistici realizzati finora. Usare questa metodologia come base per nuove produzioni; versioni future solo additive.
constraints: No narration, no lyrics, no subtitles in the film
Signature opening: ARTIST NAME + small MUSIC BY COMPOSER
One finished video, not parallel short and long variants
True museum-sourced images and verified sources
Full-screen immersive art, variety of rhythm and contemplative pauses
No split screen, gimmicks, AI repainting or automatic generic crop
Different licensed real instrumental soundtrack whenever possible
Complete legally required attributions outside film in public caption
Never change V6 baseline; create new versions and preserve rollbacks
followup_workflow: For new artist: source original artworks + map artist-specific subjects + select licensed track + write V6-style bespoke storyboard + render and QC. Never substitute artist name alone into hardcoded Van Gogh STORY. The V6 workflow exists but its end-to-end GitHub Action success should be verified before claiming.
release_media_storage: Reference video and original museum photos are backed up separately from GitHub; do not imply Git branches contain media.
